{{Top|leg}}
A '''superconductor''' was a technological component used in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. It transferred the energy from the [[Emitter matrix/Legends|emitter matrix]] to the [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]]. No energy was lost in the process.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
